Course Syllabus

MERN Full Stack Web Development Course with AI
AI Toolkit for Developers

Sprint 1: HTML & CSS Foundations

  • Build semantic web pages using modern HTML5 best practices.
  • Design responsive layouts with Flexbox, Grid, and Media Queries.
  • Create accessible websites following ARIA and accessibility guidelines.
  • Master CSS animations, transitions, and modern styling techniques.
  • Understand responsive UI development for multi-device compatibility.

Live Project: PlateCraft: Freelance Restaurant Website

Sprint 2: Bootstrap & JavaScript Foundations

  • Build responsive interfaces using Bootstrap's modern component library.
  • Learn JavaScript fundamentals including variables, operators, and conditions.
  • Implement loops, functions, and exception handling effectively.
  • Create interactive UI elements using Bootstrap and JavaScript.
  • Validate user inputs and improve application usability.

Live Project: BookMyShow: A Rapid UI Prototype Sprint

Sprint 3: JavaScript Functions & Data Structures

  • Master JavaScript functions, execution context, and hoisting concepts.
  • Work efficiently with arrays, strings, objects, Maps, and Sets.
  • Apply modern ES6 features for cleaner JavaScript development.
  • Perform complex data manipulation using built-in JavaScript methods.
  • Build reusable utility functions following modular programming principles.

Live Project: ResumeIQ: Your Own ATS Resume Scorer CLI

Sprint 4: Objects, Closures & Functional Programming

  • Design scalable applications using JavaScript object-oriented programming.
  • Understand closures, recursion, and lexical scope in depth.
  • Apply higher-order functions for efficient data transformations.
  • Use call(), apply(), bind(), and advanced object manipulation.
  • Write clean, reusable, and maintainable JavaScript code.

Live Project: ForgeTest: Build Your Own Test Framework

Read more

1: The AI Toolkit & Developer Setup

  • Map of AI tools: LLMs, code assistants, AI search, agents
  • Tool categories: chat models, IDE copilots, CLI agents
  • Evaluation framework: accuracy, context window, cost, latency
  • When AI helps vs. when it hurts: real limitations
  • Setting up an AI-powered dev environment in 30 minutes
  • Live experiment: solving the same problem with multiple tools

2: Prompt Engineering & Vibe Coding

  • Vibe coding: natural language to code (fast prototyping)
  • Anatomy of a developer prompt: role, context, task, constraints
  • Zero-shot to few-shot escalation strategy
  • Chain-of-thought prompting for better reasoning
  • Iterative prompting and fixing hallucinations

3: Spec-Driven Development with AI

  • Transition from prompts to structured specifications
  • Writing clear technical specs before code generation
  • Few-shot prompting with real codebase patterns
  • Generating reliable code aligned with requirements
  • Reducing ambiguity and improving determinism

4: RAG Systems & Context-Aware AI

  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) fundamentals
  • Embeddings, vector databases, semantic search
  • Connecting AI to codebases, docs, and internal data
  • Building developer assistants using RAG
  • Limitations and failure modes of RAG systems
